parole.significato: a Dutch trading post, a branch office of the Dutch merchants
parole.testo: Borrowed from Dutch kantoor and its obsolete spelling cantoor, from Middle Dutch contoor, contoir, comptoir, from Middle French contoir, comptoir, from conter, compter (“to count”) + -oir (instrument suffix). Doublet of computer, counter, and kontor.

parole.significato: To rule over or control arbitrarily or arrogantly; to tyrannize.
parole.testo: From Dutch domineren, from Middle French dominer.
From Dutch gouvernante, and its source, Middle French gouvernante. Compare govern.

parole.significato: A single-masted sailboat with only one headsail.
parole.testo: Borrowed from Dutch sloep. Doublet of chalupa and shallop.
